plainText:
Viaplay is a subscription service and digital media store owned and operated by . Launched in May 2007 as Viasat OnDemand, the service was renamed as Viaplay in March 2011, and is available in , , , and . Content is accessible by different methods; some is available through a monthly subscription, and others can be purchased or rented.

==Availability of the animated series==
As of May 2020, the following is available with a Viaplay subscription in Sweden , Norway , Denmark and Finland :

Season 14 - Pokémon: Black & White
Season 15 - Pokémon BW: Rival Destinies
Season 16 - Pokémon BW: Adventures in Unova and Beyond
Season 17 - Pokémon the Series: XY
Season 18 - Pokémon the Series: XY Kalos Quest
Season 19 - Pokémon the Series: XYZ
Season 20 - Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon
Season 21 - Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Adventures
Season 22 - Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Legends

==Availability of the movies==
As of May 2020, the following is available:

Pokémon 4Ever - Celebi: The Voice of the Forest

Norway - Rental: 39
